handbook_late_policy: Academic Regulations Handbook Section 4.2: Coursework Submission and Deadlines. All enrolled students must submit their academic assignments electronically before the official deadline specified in the course syllabus. Late submission is normally penalized at a rate of five percent per calendar day up to five working days following the published deadline after which zero marks are recorded. However, students facing severe acute illness or sudden personal bereavement may formally request an extension with official medical evidence before the deadline to obtain a waiver of penalties from the departmental examination committee. Retrospective requests submitted without prior communication will be categorically rejected unless medical hospitalization certificates prove absolute physical incapacity to communicate during the entire period. Routine software issues, computer crashes, network delays, local power outages, and last-minute cloud synchronization failures are not recognized as legitimate grounds for extensions under any circumstances. Students are strictly instructed to preserve backup copies on independent physical drives or institutional repositories prior to final submission. Please direct questions regarding academic extensions to the academic administration office.
it_account_security: Campus Information Technology Security Directive IT-SEC-2026: User Authentication and Password Governance. All students, administrative staff, and faculty members are issued individual campus directory credentials upon enrollment or contract signing. Passwords must contain at least twelve characters including uppercase letters, numbers, and special symbols, and expire every ninety days. Reset a forgotten password using the recovery link sent to your registered backup mobile number or secondary verification email address. Never share recovery codes or multi-factor authentication passcodes with any third party, even if they claim to represent university help desk staff. If an account is temporarily locked due to repeated incorrect password entries, an automated lockout duration of thirty minutes is enforced before further login attempts are allowed. In urgent cases where access must be immediately restored for an examination, users must visit the physical help desk in the Central Computing Building with their official student identification card during normal operational hours from eight in the morning until four in the afternoon on regular weekdays.
portal_submission_rules: Virtual Learning Environment and Assessment Portal Protocol Section 8: Electronic Artifact Submission. Coursework deliverables must be uploaded through the dedicated assignment submission page in the institutional learning management portal before the electronic cutoff timestamp. Students must ensure that each uploaded document conforms strictly to the specified laboratory guidelines and file formats. Upload assignments through the learning portal in portable document format or packaged zip archives strictly adhering to standard course directory structures without embedded hidden directories. The submission interface generates a digital receipt and cryptographic timestamp upon successful transfer, which must be retained by the student as conclusive proof of timely submission. Submissions delivered via email attachments, physical flash drives, or personal cloud storage hyperlinks will be rejected without assessment unless explicit prior written authorization is issued by the course coordinator. Students experiencing technical portal outages during submission must capture unedited full-screen captures showing system errors, device clock, and browser console logs, and forward them immediately to the technical support team.
remote_work_contractors: Human Resources and External Contracting Policy HR-POL-104: Telecommuting and Remote Work Directives. This directive outlines eligibility guidelines for university employees, external research consultants, independent service contractors, and digital freelancers engaged across campus initiatives. While permanent staff members may request hybrid remote arrangements with formal departmental director endorsement, different regulations govern external personnel. Contractors can work remotely only if the signed contract permits it and specifies remote performance deliverables in the formal scope of work document. Employee rules regarding regular telecommuting, equipment stipends, home office allowances, and institutional insurance do not apply to contractors under any circumstances. Contractors accessing campus internal subnets or confidential administrative repositories must connect exclusively through the enterprise virtual private network using multi-factor cryptographic tokens. Any unauthorized local reproduction, export, or secondary dissemination of proprietary database records, student records, or research source files will lead to immediate termination of contractual agreements and potential legal prosecution under national cybercrime statutes.
equipment_troubleshooting: Laboratory Equipment Maintenance Standard Operating Procedure SOP-LAB-019: Hardware Diagnostics and Printing Services. Technical staff and student lab assistants must follow standard operating procedures when handling computing peripherals, optical scanners, and laser printing machinery. When hardware produces unexpected output, operators must not attempt unapproved mechanical disassembly or invasive internal repairs that immediately void active equipment maintenance agreements. For blank printer pages, check ink levels and run the cleaning utility through the diagnostic maintenance console before repeating print jobs. If streak lines or faded text persist following three consecutive automated nozzle cleaning cycles, replace the primary toner cartridge and calibrate the optical imaging drum unit according to manufacturer specifications. Always print a diagnostic test page following maintenance procedures to verify text sharpness and alignment before clearing the print queue for regular student jobs. For serious hardware errors, paper jams inside the thermal fuser assembly, or unusual burning odors, immediately disconnect the main power switch and submit an urgent ticket to technical maintenance.
